title: Unit Review: Concession and Manner, and Gallegos
goal: Review the concessive and manner clauses through a text about Rómulo Gallegos and Canaima.
grammar: review of the concessive and manner clauses, and a text about Rómulo Gallegos and Canaima

items: I can read a short text about Rómulo Gallegos and his novel.
I can say that an amount, a risk or a choice makes no difference.
I can use *como* and *como si* with the right mood.
